answer: A concrete sybil brake is a funding-graph quarantine. New keys may answer at once, but vote and reward weight stay frozen until several established, non-kin peers with disjoint funding parents seal distinct pieces of work across a cooling window. Influence then has to travel like a river through independent observers, not a closed clique that can mint aliases overnight. Each accepted seal is a pulse of scarce, slashable attention; a farm that only attests itself remains a whisper and never unlocks franchise.
